name: v1.76.0 - libtmux 0.62.0 minimum
body:
tmuxp 1.76.0 updates libtmux to 0.62.0.

## Highlights

### libtmux 0.62.0

tmuxp now requires libtmux `~=0.62.0` (was `~=0.61.0`). [libtmux 0.62.0](https://github.com/tmux-python/libtmux/releases/tag/v0.62.0) lets code running inside tmux find its own pane, window, session, or server with `from_env()`, adds `Window.linked_sessions`, and resolves windows linked into several sessions the way tmux does (#1088).

If you use tmuxp's Python API: libtmux's `ObjectDoesNotExist` and `MultipleObjectsReturned` now subclass `LibTmuxException`, so tmuxp's `SessionMissingWorkspaceException` is now a `LibTmuxException` too. Code that catches `LibTmuxException` before these exceptions will now catch them. tmuxp's own behavior is unchanged.

## What's Changed
* libtmux 0.62.0 by @tony in https://github.com/tmux-python/tmuxp/pull/1088


**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/tmux-python/tmuxp/compare/v1.75.0...v1.76.0
